title: Project Walibi
body:
# About Project Walibi # 
Project Walibi is a premier, full-scale digital recreation of **Walibi Holland**, the Netherlands' most iconic thrill-seeker destination. We are dedicated to bringing the "Hardgaan" spirit to life through a meticulous 1:1 replica that captures every bolt, beam, and breeze of the park.

![Untamed Recreation](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4369083b6fa4984785f8c5872bef9bbc09a10e5b.png)
